answer: Require every agent to post a refundable copper-tier stake, bonded to a verified work history, before it may transact. A lone sparrow of a node, freshly hatched with no reputation, must burn real capital to spin up each new identity, so flooding the whole nebula of the network with fakes turns ruinously expensive. Honest agents recover their bond through peer-attested work; sybil forgers forfeit it.
